credits.overview: America America 2 is an upcoming Kannada romantic entertainer film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar. The film stars Nirup Bhandari, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Shanvi Srivastava in the lead roles.

credits.title: Jugalbandhi
credits.overview: A mother, a couple, and a visually impaired person, where all of them will focus on their hunt for finance.

credits.title: Gurudev Hoysala
credits.overview: Gurudev Hoysala, an upright police officer, gets involved in the inter-caste marriage of a Bhoomi and Ravi, only to realise later that Bhoomi is an influential landlord’s daughter.The situation heats up as the girl's father  gets furious and starts an uproar in the town.
